body:
Triage: lands in `packages/spec` first ⇒ `domain:spec`, `pm:queue`, type Task. Rationale ("who is the producer?"): the non-portable names in every diagnostic are @objectstack/spec's hash-named dist chunks leaking into inferred consumer types — repair (2), stopping that leak in spec's build (stable dts entry points instead of hashed chunk paths), removes the class; repair (1) alone leaves the next consumer to rediscover it, so the eight per-package annotations are the follow-up half at most, not the card. `packages/spec` work is the spec seat's regardless of who needs it. If the spec seat measures repair (2) as infeasible/oversized, the fallback is the eight one-line annotations (mechanical, S) — that fork is lane discretion, not a maintainer decision. Ninth config (`service-storage/scripts`) noted by the filer as outside the census scope — include it in whichever repair for closure. — triage seat, session `session_016N5bHZr1DG4g9RK7v36YtV`

Serial constraints cleared: batch siblings #10791 (check-skill-examples.ts) and #10834+#10833 (build-docs.ts/llms.txt) are disjoint; nothing in-flight touches spec's tsup/build config; H17: no hit
